subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a native multi-turn model lease for `/model --turns N`, and should that contract live in slash-command/session state only or also in Gateway/chat API and per-model config?
rationale: The request changes public command syntax, persisted session state, provider/auth routing, and config surface, and it overlaps with open one-turn and media-revert work that maintainers should unify before implementation.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract
options.body: Define one maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway or config API against that shared contract.

options.title: Sequence after one-turn API
options.body: Keep this issue open while #83565 or its successor settles the atomic one-turn override contract, then decide whether N-turn leases build on it.

options.title: Decline native leases
options.body: Close after documenting manual `/model default`, one-turn overrides, or external operational policy as the supported cost-governance path.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract
recommendation.body: Define one maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway or config API against that shared contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the current session model override, Gateway patch, and live model switch behavior that would own the product contract.
